fact: Econostrum reports that Algeria's national statistics office (ONS) published a demography report for 2020-2023 built on an exhaustive survey of the communes' civil-status services covering births, deaths, stillbirths and marriages.
The ONS demography report for 2020-2023 gives births registered (under 900,000 in 2023) and deaths (192,000 in 2023) from the communes' civil-status services, per Econostrum.
